title: Multi-Resolution Cross-System Spatial Runtime Integration
objective: Implement explicit cross-system adapters proving one accepted spatial law preserves semantic meaning across abstract travel/pathfinding/pursuit, topology/tactical movement, combat/range, and at least one non-combat owner system, across multiple presentation resolutions, without treating geometry as rendering or creating duplicate owner state.
acceptance: One accepted spatial-law fingerprint is consumed by abstract travel/pathfinding/pursuit, tactical movement, combat/range and at least one non-combat owner adapter.
Adapters preserve the same topology, metric, containment/scale, orientation/frame and contextual semantics relevant to each owner instead of reinterpreting the law per subsystem.
Projection/resolution changes do not change the accepted law fingerprint or canonical owner identity.
Travel/pathfinding/pursuit semantics demonstrate geometry affects route cost/reachability rather than rendering only.
Tactical movement demonstrates the same law affects local adjacency/frame/metric outcomes.
Combat/range demonstrates the same law affects distance/range/projectile semantics without creating combat-owned geometry truth.
At least one non-combat owner system consumes the same law through a typed adapter without duplicate canonical state.
Cross-system discrepancies fail explicit equivalence checks rather than silently normalizing semantic drift.
Blocking integration workflows remain semantic/nonvisual, keyboard-capable, provider-off and paid-cloud independent.
boundaries: MSLR-01/03/04/07/08/13/14 and upstream completed programs remain sealed.
Travel/pathfinding/pursuit, tactical movement, combat/range and non-combat owners retain their canonical domain state and operation authority.
MCS/presentation remains projection authority; resolution or rendering cannot redefine spatial law.
GPR/Action/Event retain generic execution and immutable Event history.
MSLR-18 remains unauthorized until MSLR-16 closeout.
next_action: MSLR-16 is completed_verified. MSLR-18 — Golden Impossible-Space Proof & MSWI Handoff — is selected_not_started and awaits the next owner Continue.
